create_load_region_maps: create a function that loads region mapping data from a file and returns region id to name dictionaries
build_region_maps_from_file: build a region map dictionary from a semicolon-delimited region file containing name and id pairs
test_load_region_maps: test the load_region_maps function with a sample region file containing PHI region entries
summarize_load_region_maps: summarize the load_region_maps function that parses region files and returns id and name mapping dictionaries
review_load_region_maps: review the load_region_maps function that filters unknown regions and creates bidirectional id mappings
